services.title: Purchase Management
services.description: Digitally onboard suppliers, create and approve purchase requisitions, manage RFQs and sourcing, issue POs, track deliveries, match invoices and automate payments — complete P2P lifecycle visibility.

sections.title: Vendor Onboarding & Management
sections.description: Digitally onboard, validate and manage suppliers through a structured registration, KYC, compliance and approval process. Build a centralized and reliable supplier master.

sections.title: Purchase Requisition (PR) Management
sections.description: Create, import, track and approve purchase requisitions with configurable workflows and budget controls. Provide procurement teams complete visibility into demand.
sections.result: Full demand visibility for procurement teams.

sections.title: RFQ & Strategic Sourcing
sections.description: Convert approved requirements into RFQs, invite qualified suppliers, receive quotations and identify the best commercial offer through structured comparison and sourcing.
sections.result: Best commercial offers through structured sourcing.

sections.title: Purchase Order (PO) Management
sections.description: Convert approved requisitions or sourcing awards into purchase orders with controlled approvals, commercial terms and complete order visibility.
sections.result: Controlled POs with full audit trail.

sections.title: Order Confirmation & ASN
sections.description: Collaborate digitally with suppliers after PO release. Capture order acknowledgements and Advance Shipping Notices to improve visibility of upcoming deliveries.
sections.result: Upcoming delivery visibility for all stakeholders.

sections.title: Goods Receipt & Quality Management
sections.description: Track material receipt against purchase orders and perform inspection and quality checks to ensure supplied goods meet quantity and quality requirements.
sections.result: Quality assured receipts with performance tracking.

sections.title: Invoice Management & 3-Way Match
sections.description: Digitize supplier invoice processing and automatically validate invoices against purchase orders and goods receipts before posting for payment.

sections.title: Payments, Analytics & Reporting
sections.description: Track invoice and payment status while providing procurement teams with real-time dashboards for spend, savings, supplier performance and operational KPIs.

services.title: Vendor Management
services.tagline: Manage the complete vendor lifecycle — from onboarding to archival.
services.description: A centralized, ERP-integrated platform that streamlines vendor registration, onboarding, compliance verification, approvals, categorization, and performance monitoring. Seamlessly synchronize vendor master data with your ERP and automate approval workflows to ensure data consistency, stronger governance, improved compliance, and efficient vendor lifecycle management.

sections.title: Vendor Invitation & Self-Registration
sections.description: Simplify vendor onboarding with a secure, centralized portal that enables prospective vendors to register and submit their business information.
points: Configurable registration forms and mandatory fields
Duplicate registration checks using key vendor identifiers
sections.result: Faster vendor registration with reduced manual data entry.

sections.title: Vendor Profile & Classification
sections.description: Create standardized vendor profiles with structured business information to support accurate vendor master data and effective sourcing.
points: Company details, legal entity, and registered address
GST, PAN, MSME/Udyam, and applicable registration details
Bank account and authorized contact information
Product, service, material, and Capex category mapping
Vendor classification by geography and business type

sections.title: Document Management & Compliance
sections.description: Centralize vendor documentation and monitor compliance requirements throughout the onboarding process and beyond.
points: Upload GST, PAN, bank proof, certifications, and other required documents
Configure mandatory and optional documents by vendor category
Track document submission and verification status
Monitor expiry dates and trigger renewal reminders
Maintain a centralized repository of vendor documents
sections.result: Organized vendor documentation and proactive compliance tracking.

sections.title: Vendor Verification & Risk Assessment
sections.description: Assess vendor eligibility and identify potential risks before onboarding approval through configurable verification and screening controls.
points: Detect potential duplicate vendors using GST, PAN, and other identifiers
Verify statutory, business, and banking information against available sources
Enable optional sanctions, restricted-party, and internal blacklist screening
Flag discrepancies and potential compliance risks for review
Classify vendors based on defined risk criteria
sections.result: Stronger vendor due diligence and early risk identification.

sections.title: Multi-Level Approval Workflow
sections.description: Automate vendor approval processes through configurable workflows that establish accountability and support timely onboarding decisions.
points: Route applications to Procurement, Finance, Compliance, and other authorized approvers
Configure approval hierarchies based on business rules and vendor categories
Send SLA-based reminders and escalation notifications
Manage rework, resubmission, and rejection with comments
Maintain a complete audit trail of approvals, decisions, and timestamps
sections.result: Faster, transparent, and fully traceable vendor approvals.

sections.title: Vendor Activation & ERP Integration
sections.description: Activate approved vendors for business transactions and synchronize vendor master data with connected enterprise systems.
points: Manage vendor statuses such as Active, Inactive, Blocked, and Blacklisted
Synchronize approved vendor master data with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, and other supported platforms
Map relevant vendor fields between ATILA and the ERP
Monitor synchronization status and identify failed or pending transfers
Enable eligible vendors for RFQs, purchase orders, and invoice processes, as applicable
sections.result: ERP-aligned vendor master data and faster transaction readiness.

sections.title: Continuous Compliance & Performance Monitoring
sections.description: Maintain ongoing vendor compliance and evaluate supplier performance throughout the business relationship.
points: Track document validity, expiry dates, and pending renewals
Send automated notifications for outstanding compliance requirements
Monitor vendor performance against configured quality, delivery, and service parameters
Trigger reviews, escalations, or temporary transaction restrictions based on configured policies
Support vendor classification as Approved, Preferred, or Strategic based on defined criteria
sections.result: Continuous compliance, improved supplier performance, and better sourcing decisions.

sections.title: Vendor Exit & Archival
sections.description: Manage vendor suspension, deactivation, blacklisting, and exit through a controlled process that preserves historical records and supports audit requirements.
points: Initiate vendor suspension or deactivation with appropriate authorization
Restrict transactions for blocked or inactive vendors according to configured rules
Synchronize approved vendor status changes with connected ERP systems
Archive inactive or exited vendor records while preserving historical transaction data
Maintain an audit trail of status changes, approvals, and exit decisions
sections.result: Controlled vendor exits, preserved audit history, and a clean, well-governed vendor database.

services.title: O2C - Order to Cash Cycle
services.description: Automate the entire order-to-cash cycle — from customer inquiry through payment collection — to accelerate cash flow, reduce DSO and improve customer satisfaction.

sections.title: Customer Inquiry
sections.description: Capture customer requirements, products, quantities, specifications and expected delivery dates. Convert qualified inquiries into quotations.
points: Multi-channel inquiry capture — web, email, phone
sections.result: No lead falls through the cracks.

sections.title: Customer Onboarding
sections.description: Digitally onboard customers with company details, GST/KYC documents, billing and shipping locations, contacts, payment terms and approval workflows.
points: Payment terms and credit limit setup

sections.title: Quotation & Pricing
sections.description: Create quotations using approved product and customer-specific price lists. Manage discounts, taxes, validity periods and commercial terms.

sections.title: Sales Order Confirmation
sections.description: Convert accepted quotations or customer POs into confirmed sales orders. Validate item, quantity, pricing, delivery terms and approvals before confirmation.

sections.title: Order Scheduling
sections.description: Plan delivery schedules against confirmed orders based on requested dates and availability. Support multiple schedules and partial fulfillment.

sections.title: Dispatch & Delivery
sections.description: Plan dispatch, capture transporter and vehicle details, track dispatched quantities and maintain delivery documentation and POD.

sections.title: Invoice Management
sections.description: Generate invoices against dispatched quantities with applicable taxes and commercial terms, and make invoices available to customers digitally.

sections.title: Payment & Receivables
sections.description: Track invoice due dates, outstanding amounts, partial/full payments and overdue receivables until payment is received and reconciled.

services.tagline: Plan, track and control procurement budgets
services.description: Set budgets, align spend to approvals and monitor budget vs actuals across every procurement transaction — with alerts before limits are exceeded.

sections.title: Budget Planning & Allocation
sections.description: Define budgets by cost center, category, project or department.
points: Import budgets from ERP or spreadsheets
sections.result: Clear budget ownership from day one.

sections.title: Budget Requests & Approvals
sections.description: Budget additions and revisions follow a governed approval flow.

sections.title: Commitment & Encumbrance Tracking
sections.description: Every PR, PO and contract reserves budget in real time.
points: PR, PO and contract commitments reserve budget
Receipts and invoice adjustments update instantly

sections.title: Budget vs Actual Tracking
sections.description: Compare planned, committed and actual spend continuously.
points: Planned vs committed vs actual comparison
Variance by cost center, category and period
sections.result: Full visibility into spend against plan.

sections.title: Alerts & Threshold Controls
sections.description: Configurable limits keep spending within policy.
points: Hard blocks or overrides with justification

sections.title: Budget Analytics & Reporting
sections.description: Finance gets the numbers it needs for review and forecasting.
